checks.note: Manager decision on #295 H6. Validity checks block a run from the fit and from J: a status not in ok_statuses (setting_refused, frame_map, ocr_error, error, not_activated), a validity_pass column at 0 (measurement rules M1 to M4 and M8), a missing repeat. Every other pass_* column is a known-result equation: a miss is reported per row and in the results, never blocking.

validity_rules.note: Rules of one D run owned by spec/step2d.mjs D_ROW_RULES (M1 input, M2 CPU of both phases, M3 RAM base and OS peak of both phases, M4 retained bytes, M5 beta > 0, M6 frames mapped by time); a broken rule blocks like a validity pass_* row.

eq3_z_cpu.equation: C_way / N_new = c_0(m) + px * kappa_c(L, m, c), C_way = way_cpu_ns (conversion, compression, writing, training; M2); C_dec = N_dec * px * kappa_d(L, m)

eq4_z_ram.title: Z RAM
eq4_z_ram.equation: M_comp = M_0 + M_cctx(L, W) + B_c * px * 3 (+ M_train = mu * S_samples for a dictionary, S_samples = N_train * px * 3); M_dec = M_0 + M_dctx(W) + B_d * px * 3 + b_max + m_d0

residuals.note: max_abs_rel and rms_rel are of M_comp; dec is of M_dec

eq6_run_time.title: run time
eq6_run_time.equation: T = sum over runs of N_new * px * 3 / v(L, m) * repeats

eq7_d_bytes.equation: DW2: folded: bytes_D = n_new * px * p_folded_E,c * exp(a_folded_E * q) at tau_f 20; no other tau_f (no GOP sweep) | DW1: folded: bytes_D = n_new * px * p_folded_E,c * exp(a_folded_E * q) at tau_f 20; at the folder and q of a GOP sweep (q 70), first: bytes_D = (n_new - n_key) * P_split + n_key * K_split (P_K_split, measured); another tau_f at q 70 in another folder: bytes_D(tau_f) = bytes_D(tau_f 20) * ((n_new - n_key) + n_key * r_q) / ((n_new - n_key0) + n_key0 * r_q), n_key = ceil(n_new / tau_f), n_key0 = ceil(n_new / 20), r_q = K_over_P_at_q

eq7_d_quality.equation: Q_ssim = 1 - s_E,c * exp(-g_E * q); Q_psnr = m_E,c + l_E * q

eq7_d_cpu.title: D CPU
eq7_d_cpu.equation: a_rt = n_new * px * c_comp(-3) + n_new * c_file; a_w = n_new * px * (c_dec(-3) + c_conv) + n_new * c_enc(E, q, px); c_enc = e0_E + e1_E * px * (1 + e2_E * q)

eq7_d_ram.title: D RAM
eq7_d_ram.equation: M_D = M_live + M_worker; M_worker = M0_w + px * (3 + 1.5) * d + M_enc(E, px); M_enc = m0_E + m1_E * px

eq7_d_qmin.title: D q_min
eq7_d_qmin.equation: q_min(E, px) = min { q : R = 1 on every text scenario } (training rows; reported, O is judged at the q run)
